name: Payments from or to unrelated third parties
description: Funds are paid or received, or instructions are given to pay, through parties with no evident link to the customer, contract, debt or insured interest. Includes third-party cheques, loan repayments, premiums, gaming funds and goods payments not matching the documentation.
fp: Legitimate third-party payers exist, such as family members, parents, guarantors, payment agents or corporate treasury entities, and are usually explainable with documentation.

links.name: Frequent third-party payments
links.ctx: Funds regularly sent or received from parties with no clear link to the customer.
links.fp: Family support, agents and platforms use third parties.

links.name: Deposit of third-party cheque from unknown payer
links.ctx: Payee and depositor have no relationship.

links.name: Cash deposits mixed with unrelated third-party funds
links.ctx: Deposits include cheques, transfers or cash from persons unconnected to trading, or rotated across several business accounts.
links.fp: Owners may inject funds legitimately as capital.

links.name: Third-party funding of play
links.ctx: Funds from third parties or unusual bank sources pay for play.

links.name: Instructions to transfer funds to third parties without explanation
links.ctx: Sudden redirection of funds to unrelated beneficiaries.

links.name: Premiums paid by unrelated third parties
links.ctx: Payers have no insurable interest or link.

links.name: Borrower repays from unrelated third-party sources
Third-party payments for unrelated debts or purchases
links.ctx: Payers settle obligations of others without clear relationship, often in trade or loan context.
links.fp: Guarantors or group treasury pay for others.

links.name: Payment from or to unrelated third parties
links.ctx: Payments for goods come from parties not named in the contract or documentation.
links.fp: Group treasury centres and factoring can legitimately pay.

links.name: Payments from or to unrelated third parties
links.ctx: Payers or payees have no apparent link to the customer.
